description: This file defines the CassandraClusteringTable class which implements the IMembershipTable interface for managing cluster membership data in Cassandra within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for initializing, reading, inserting, updating, and cleaning up membership entries, utilizing Cassandra sessions and queries.

classes.name: CassandraClusteringTable
classes.description: Implements the IMembershipTable interface for managing cluster membership data in Cassandra within Orleans.

methods.name: CassandraClusteringTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CassandraClusteringTable with configuration options and service provider.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table by creating a Cassandra session and ensuring the necessary table and cluster version exist.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a specified cluster ID.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry if it does not already exist or is outdated.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry with new data.

methods.name: GetMembershipEntry
methods.description: Converts a Cassandra row into a MembershipEntry object.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all membership entries from Cassandra.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific membership row by SiloAddress.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a membership entry, with optional TTL behavior.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes inactive or outdated silo entries based on a cutoff date.
